# Dan Levy

> Dan Levy is a Senior Software Engineer at HubSpot (Boston, MA) specializing in design systems, web accessibility (WCAG), and frontend infrastructure. Previously at Qualtrics. B.S. Computer Science, Florida Institute of Technology (2020).
